title: Code and data for "Circuit-aware protection against burst errors in lattice surgery"
description:
Simulation data and analysis code for the paper Circuit-aware protection against burst errors in lattice surgery (E. Kim). The archive contains per-event failure counts for six simulation studies of a distance-9 and distance-13 lattice-surgery CNOT under burst errors (the protection-count sweep, the original Fig. 2a, Fig. 5a and Fig. 5b,c cohorts, a realistic-decoder study and a response-model study), the stored analyses of the distance-9 mechanism studies, SHA-256 checksums, and Python code that recomputes every reported value from the per-event counts and compares it with the paper.

Version 1.1.0 adds data/calibration_extension/, which is not part of the paper: a pre-registered rerun of the Fig. 2a layouts on the protection-count sweep's 600-impact bank. It varies impact energy up to the Willow-calibrated scale, standard versus echoed decoupling, and protected-site trapping and gap. The deep/typed advantage is resolved only for small impacts (eta = 1.43 [1.11, 1.90] at the paper's scale) and vanishes from ten times that energy upward.

Reproduce with pip install -r requirements.txt followed by ./step1_verify_data.sh, ./step2_recompute_results.sh and ./step3_compare_with_paper.sh. File formats are described in data/README.md.
